diagnosis: The endpoint connects to Temporal and fetches the output of an asynchronous tax calculation workflow by workflowId from req.params. It ensures the caller is logged in, but never checks if the workflow belongs to the user's business. Any user can poll and retrieve sensitive corporate tax returns and payroll schedules generated by other companies' workflows.
exploit_request:
GET /api/jobs/tax-calculation/wf_tax_2025_acme_corp_44102/result HTTP/1.1
Host: tax.financesuite.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
